falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes below 4200 at any point in next 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The 78% pattern match to bottom_2024_aug is invalidated because the August 2024 low held above 5200; a drop to 4200 would represent a fundamentally different market structure (deeper correction/bear market) not consistent with that bottom pattern

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes above 35 for 2 consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The BLOWOFF SCORE of 38 suggests controlled selling/possible exhaustion; sustained VIX above 35 indicates panic-driven institutional de-risking, invalidating the 'bottom' signal and implying the pattern match was to a pre-capitulation phase rather than an actual bottom

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y-2Y Treasury yield curve uninverts and steepens to +50bps or wider
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A rapid un-inversion with steepening typically signals recession confirmation and Fed emergency cuts; this would invalidate the bottom call because August 2024 occurred with curve still inverted, and recession pricing contradicts a tactical bottom formation

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
